messages:
alex: Heads-up, I just got paged for a spike of 5xx errors hitting /v1/generate. I have a 30m handoff starting in ~25m — need to assign driver + comms before I go. Incident looks like customer-impacting for some realtime routes (latency + errors).
incident-bot: ALERT: 5xx error rate > 10% for service=inference-api env=prod detected at 2026-03-14T09:12:03Z. PagerDuty: PD-INC-4321.
alex: Quick context: metric surge started ~09:08, error type is HTTP 502/503 from inference runtime. No escalation yet beyond oncall. I recommend: 1) pick a driver to follow runbook, 2) pick comms owner to post status updates to #incidents and to customer Slack if needed, 3) check capacity and fallback model routing.
jay: I can take driver for the next 2 hours. I'll start triage now. If I get blocked at infra-level I'll flag to platform.
sara: I'll own comms. I'll start a status message in #incidents and DM the AE for the impacted customer set. I'll post cadence every 15m or on important changes.
alex: Thanks. @jay please run the quick triage steps in the runbook and paste output. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-5xx (internal). Key steps below: ```Runbook excerpt:\n1) Check pods: kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=inference
2) Check recent logs: kubectl logs -n inference --tail=200 $(kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=inference -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
3) Check model-variant routing: curl -sS -u token:x -X GET https://controlplane.internal/v1/routes?service=inference
4) If durable failure, switch traffic to variant B: POST /v1/routes/switch {"route":"inference","variant":"model-variant-b"}
```
jay: Triage notes: pods all `Running` but saw repeated connection reset errors in logs around 09:06. Example: `ERROR: kvcache miss -> grpc: received RST_STREAM` repeating. Rolling restart of one replica reduces immediate errors but not overall rate.
sara: Posting first update to #incidents: "We are investigating increased 5xx errors for inference API. Jay is driving triage, Sara owning comms. Customers potentially affected on realtime routes. Next update in 15m or on change." :hourglass_flowing_sand:
maria: I'm scheduled to pick up the late shift at 00:00 UTC but can extend earlier if needed. I can be secondary backup for 03:00-05:00 UTC coverage gap if someone can't.
jay: I'm going to check network path to the model servers and also verify fallback behavior in staging with a canary switch. If I can't confirm fallback works in 10m, I'll ask platform to trigger the variant switch.
alex: Important: during the handoff at 09:35 I'll explicitly hand driver to whoever is oncall next. If you're leaving @jay, say so and confirm handoff steps. Also Sara, please save the status template so the next comms owner can reuse it.
sara: Saved template and will attach a short incident summary in the ticket. Also pinging AE group for customers with SLO exposure.
jay: Update: verified fallback path in staging — switching traffic to model-variant-b reduces error rate to baseline. I recommend switching prod routing as rollback-safe mitigation. Need :thumbsup: from platform or an approver if anyone is oncall with permission.
maria: I can approve the switch if you want me to; I'm on backup with permission to perform route changes.
alex: Ok — @maria approved, @jay perform prod route switch and report back. Sara continue comms. I'll start the handoff doc in the PD incident and set the next owner.
jay: Done. Performed route switch at ~09:27. Error rate dropping, currently at ~2.3%. Logs show reduced RST_STREAM entries. Will keep monitoring.
sara: Posted status update and notified impacted AE list. Next update in 15m.
alex: Good. For the handoff: I'm handing driver -> jay (until 11:30 local), comms -> sara (until 12:00 local). Secondary coverage is maria from 00:00-05:00 UTC and can approve route ops. Coverage gap noted 03:30-04:15 UTC if no one volunteers — pls sync with oncall schedule if you can cover.
maria: I'll take the 03:30-04:15 slot if needed, mark it in the rota.
jay: I'll keep driver until 11:30 and then do a full briefing in the PD ticket before stepping off.
sara: Will hand off comms in-thread and drop the summary into the incident ticket so the next comms owner has the timeline.
alex: Thanks everyone. I'll close this handoff thread when PD-INC-4321 is stable for 30m and the postmortem owner is assigned. :white_check_mark:
